explanation.intro: Photosynthesis is how plants make their own food.

steps.title: The Ingredients
steps.text: Plants need sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make food.

steps.title: Inside the Plant
steps.text: This happens inside special cells called chloroplasts.

steps.title: The Process
steps.text: Sunlight helps them turn water and carbon dioxide into sugar (food) for the plant.

explanation.answer: Plants use sunlight, water, and air to create their own food through photosynthesis!
explanation.followup: How do you think plants get energy from this process?

nextTopic.reason: Understanding cellular respiration is crucial for understanding how plants convert sunlight into energy and ultimately, how all living organisms get the energy they need.
nextTopic.relatedTo: Photosynthesis provides the initial step in converting light energy to chemical energy (glucose), while cellular respiration uses this glucose to release energy.
